Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic The buyer organization is an institution eligible for concessional rates of GST as notified by the Government of India. The goods for which bids have been invited fall under classification of GST concession and the conditions for eligibility of concession are met by the institution. A certificate to this effect will be issued by Buyer to the Seller after award of the Contract. Sellers are requested to submit their bids after accounting for the Concessional rate of GST. Applicable Concessional rate of GST : 5 % Notification No.and date : dated 25/01/2018 3. Scope of Supply

Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 4. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 25% of total value. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses * Applicable GST@5% * Quantity indicated is in M3(2100 M3) 1.Supplier shall pick the empty cylinders from PCR, fill them and deliver back filled cylinders to PCR. 2. Each cylinder to be filled with 7m3 of GH2 (~50-liter cylinder) at 140 bar pressure 3.Supply shall be in lot of 20 to 22 cylinders in each batch 4. Total Quantity of gaseous Hydrogen to be supplied: 2100m3 (300 cylinders of each 7 m3GH2) 5. Quantity variation of ± 10% is allowed 6.Payment: Payment will be made on pro-rata basis for the actual quantity supplied against each lot at the time of delivery, upon receipt and acceptance at PCR and duly certified by Purchaser representative 7.Total contract Period is ONE year. However, the contract may be extended for ONE more YEAR on mutua l agreement with same rates, terms and conditions of the PO.The successful bidder shall give acceptance f or this clause. 8.Contractor has to deliver the filled cylinders within 7 days from the date of collection of empty cylinders f rom Propellant Complex, Rasayani. 9.Contractor has to submit Bank Guarantee or All risk insurance for Rs. 1,50,000/- (One Lakh Fi fty Thousand Rupees) towards cost of empty cylinders being sent to contractor premises for h ydrogen filling. 10.Penalty Clause:If supplier fails to supply GH2 within 10 days period after intimation given by purchaser, then a penalty of 0.5% of lot value i.e., 22 cylinders hydrogen supply cost (as per PO rates) will be levied f or each one-week delay. 11.The Bidder shall be a party who has already executed similar / identical works (supply of Gaseous Hydr ogen) with minimum 3 years of experience. Documentary proofs (purchase order) shall be submitted in thi s regard. 12.If bidder is an authorized dealer, they have to submit dealer authorization certificate from manufacture r. 13.Supplier / Authorized dealer shall have valid PESO license for filling, supply & transportation of GH2 cyli nders, as applicable, and documentary evidence has to be provided for the same with the offer. 14.Offers from the bidders who are operating their gaseous hydrogen supply location within th e radius of 150kms from PCR (purchaser)shall only be considered. This is to optimize the landed c ost which consists of GH2 supply cost and transportation expenses. . 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
